sources.fasta: Pre-existing UCSC-named mm10/GRCm38 genomic FASTA, 66 contigs; original download URL unrecorded.

bridge_policy: Corrected 18-nt cores agree with author BridgeSequences.xlsx and every published P1/P2. Historical extra G is not used.

candidate_generation.policy: All M4 transcripts; step 1; unique 52-nt ACGT windows within gene; both on-bits per window. Pair IDs namespace unchanged native window IDs by transcript and bit.

ground_truth: 317 genes; 45648 unique complete 88-nt oligos; 22824 independently confirmed 25+2+25 pairs; no exclusions.
pair_id_policy: Namespace native extraction probe_id by transcript and on-bit; retain both roles of the same native construction row. No cross-row pairing.
